minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved policy changes, the Q3 commitment and a Wright Pierce contract; the FY24 budget stays open.
minutes.summary: The Sewer Commission met by Zoom and reviewed the operating budget, which will stay on every agenda until the Finance Committee presentation. It approved sewer-use policy changes for a Feb 28 public hearing, the Q3 commitment, a consulting contract with Wright Pierce and the prior minutes. Other items were the business manager appointment, the Pond View 40B status and grease trap compliance.

votes.motion: Approve the sewer-use policy changes (annual permit fee, deduct meter policy) as part of the public hearing package
votes.outcome: passed; Brett, Mike and Dave aye, chair presumably also aye
passed; the chair said the motion passed

votes.motion: Accept the contract with Wright Pierce

budget_items.what_was_said: The draft is not due final until the Finance Committee presentation. Betterments, debt service and transfers are to be added by the Feb 28 meeting.
The lines are offsetting revenue and expense placeholders that net to zero. Barbara will ask the town accountant and town manager whether to keep them.
No rate increase has been announced by either city. Barbara will check with both before the next meeting.

budget_items.topic: Annual permit fees for grease trap and oil-water separator
budget_items.what_was_said: Counsel objected to non-flat fees, so a single flat annual fee is proposed for internal and external customers. Non-compliance would draw an invoice after 30 days, then a daily charge.
Q3 bills went out Feb 1 and the commitment amount was stated for approval.

budget_items.topic: Daily non-compliance fee at a grease trap customer
budget_items.what_was_said: None of the daily fee assessed since November 11th has been received. The commission is pressing for compliance.
The contract was accepted by the commission and goes to the town manager to sign.
Maintenance is scattered across several lines. The planned capital line covers pump station upgrades and manhole repairs, with ARPA revenue offsetting.

decisions.decision: A public hearing on sewer use regulation updates will be held Feb 28 at the start of the regular meeting.
The budget stays on every agenda until after the Finance Committee presentation.
Barbara will contact Fitchburg and Leominster about rate increases before the next meeting.
The annual report will be corrected to show 3-year terms for John and Mike appointed in May 2022.
Pond View stays on the agenda for visibility while the housing appeals committee review is pending.
Commissioners may attend the Il Forno grease trap pump-out on Friday between 7:30 and 8 am.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission approved a package of sewer-use policy changes, including an annual permit fee and a deduct meter policy, for a public hearing.
The commission approved the Q3 sewer bills commitment.
The commission accepted a consulting contract with Wright Pierce, which goes to the town manager to sign.
The draft operating budget stays open and on every agenda until after the Finance Committee presentation.
A public hearing on the sewer use regulation updates was set for Feb 28 at the start of the regular meeting.

why_it_matters: The permit fee and deduct meter policy change what some sewer customers, including grease trap holders, are charged and what happens if they do not comply.
The sewer budget is still a draft: betterments, debt service and transfers are not yet in it, so the figures a resident sees later may differ from this stage.
watch_next: Public hearing on the sewer use regulation updates, Feb 28, at the start of the Sewer Commission's regular meeting.
Updated operating budget with betterments, debt service and transfers added, due by the Feb 28 meeting, ahead of the Finance Committee presentation.
